title: Prominence on 30A Happi Nest Prominence on 30A
meta_description: Prominence - Happi Nest - Beach, 4 Bikes, 2 Pools, The Big Chill
description_expanded: AboutProminence 30A rental, Happi Nest, located in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways is a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES * 2 Bedroom - 30A * Use of Owners Beach Toys/Gear * * Spacious Fully Equipped Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar * Large Living Area w/Full Sleeper Sofa * Master Bedroom w/King Bed * 2nd Bedroom w/Queen and Twin/Twin Bunk Bed * Full-Size Washer/Dryer * FREE Wi-Fi * Sleeps 7 PLEASE NOTE: * Use of the owners Beach Gear and Beach Toys are included with your stay. However, should any item become lost or should a bike become unavailable due to loss, flat tire or similar there will be no refund as the use provided is at the courtesy of the owner. The owner's bikes mentioned are in addition to the 4 rental bikes offered to you if you decide to reserve them. About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, Florida Prominence is one of the most popular communities on 30A and features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Prominence is perfectly located to new and long time 30A haunts as well as the beautiful white beaches of Scenic 30A. Guests will enjoy a beautiful town center and 2 resort style pools. Located at the town center, the Big Chill is a hot-spot for entertainment and features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen for sporting events and movie nights on the green. Concerts, family activities, restaurants, and boutique shops are just some of the things to do within a less than 5 minute walk. Prominence is centrally located on 30A between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to the east. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES Walking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly Entertainment Cigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular Hangout Onsite Ice Machine Kids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub 2 Large Community Pool(s) with Zero Entry (no steps) – perfect for the elderly and toddlers Barbecue Areas Proximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside 5 miles to nearest Grocery Store ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round * 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round * 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
